# War Scroll Column 17 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 17 | **Condition:** fragmentary

---

**1** In the seventh lot, the great hand of God shall subdue [Belial and al]l the angels of his dominion and all the men of

**2** [his lot.] [...] The holy ones shall shine forth [...] to pursue [...] in utter

**3** destruction. And the priests shall blow the trumpets [...] and all the battle lines shall deploy

**4** against them [...] and the Sons of Light shall shine forth with the angelic host [...] in the truth of God, to strengthen

**5** [...] the Sons of Light. And they shall raise a great shout [...] and the dominion of [...]

**6** shall melt away, and the angels [...] shall strengthen [...] the covenant of God [...] in the midst of the battle [...]

**7** For this is the time appointed by God to bring low the prince of the dominion of wickedness. And He shall send

**8** eternal aid to the lot of His redemption through the power of the angel — He has magnified the authority of Michael

**9** in eternal light, to illumine with joy the covenant of Israel, peace and blessing for the lot of God, to exalt

**10** the authority of Michael among the divine beings and the dominion of Israel among all flesh.

**11** And righteousness shall rejoice on high, and all the sons of His truth shall be glad in eternal knowledge.

**12** And you, Sons of His covenant, be strong in God's testing, until He lifts His hand

**13** and completes His trials — the mystery of His works. [...] And at the appointed time He shall bring low forever

**14** the Sons of Darkness; and there shall be no remnant and there shall be no survivor among the Sons of

**15** Darkness. [...] And the righteous shall shine forth [...] unto all the appointed times of

**16** eternity. [...] And the dominion of the Kittim shall come to an end, wickedness shall be vanquished without

**17** [rem]nant, and there shall be no survivor among all the Sons of Darkness [...]

---

*LOGOS notes: Column 17 describes the climactic seventh engagement — God's decisive intervention through Michael. "Divine beings" renders elim (17:10), the Qumran term for angelic beings. "Kittim" preserved as a proper noun (standard DSS usage for Rome/occupying power). Line divisions follow Yadin's standard edition.*
